mapper.select:
SELECT disaster_id, disaster_name, disaster_type, occurrence_time, position, extra_info, create_time FROM (
SELECT CAST(rl.disaster_id AS VARCHAR) AS disaster_id, rl.disaster_name, 'rain' AS disaster_type, rl.occurrence_time, rl.position, rl.rainfall AS extra_info, rl.create_time FROM xian_disaster_rain rl WHERE (rl.is_deleted = 0 OR rl.is_deleted IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(xel.disaster_id AS VARCHAR) AS disaster_id, xel.disaster_name, 'earthquake' AS disaster_type, xel.occurrence_time, xel.position, xel.magnitude AS extra_info, xel.create_time FROM xian_earthquake_list xel WHERE (xel.is_deleted = 0 OR xel.is_deleted IS NULL) ) AS all_disasters
AND disaster_type = #{disasterType}
ORDER BY create_time DESC

select.if: SELECT rao.id, rao.rain_id AS disaster_id, 'rain' AS disaster_type, rao.rain_queue_id AS queue_id, rao.code, rao.file_type, rao.file_name, rao.file_extension, rao.file_size, rao.source_file, rao.local_source_file, rao.remark, rao.size, rao.type, rao.create_time, rao.update_time, rao.is_deleted FROM rain_assessment_output rao WHERE rao.rain_id >= CONCAT('R', #{startTime}) AND rao.rain_id <= CONCAT(CONCAT('R', #{endTime}), '999999') AND (rao.is_deleted = 0 OR rao.is_deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY rao.create_time DESC

SELECT ao.id, ao.eq_id AS disaster_id, 'earthquake' AS disaster_type, ao.eqqueue_id AS queue_id, ao.code, ao.file_type, ao.file_name, ao.file_extension, ao.file_size, ao.source_file, ao.local_source_file, ao.remark, ao.size, ao.type, ao.create_time, ao.update_time, ao.is_deleted FROM assessment_output ao WHERE ao.eq_id >= CONCAT('T', #{startTime}) AND ao.eq_id <= CONCAT(CONCAT('T', #{endTime}), '999999') AND (ao.is_deleted = 0 OR ao.is_deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY ao.create_time DESC

delete.if: DELETE FROM xian_disaster_rain WHERE disaster_id = CAST(#{disasterId} AS INTEGER)
